BAL.text: Ravens acquired Jacoby Brissett from ARI after Joe Fagnano started Thursday's 33-10 loss to JAX. Lamar Jackson (thumb) and Tyler Huntley (toe) on IR.

LA.text: DE Myles Garrett (knee) activated from IR Saturday, no designation at WAS.
Secondary: CB Jaylen Watson (shoulder) placed on IR Saturday; CB Trent McDuffie (back) questionable at WAS.

GB.text: OL: T Travis Glover (knee) and G Sean Rhyan (ankle) ruled out at NE. LB Zaire Franklin (shin) out; CB Keisean Nixon (groin) questionable.

DET.text: LB Jack Campbell (neck) moved to IR. CB D.J. Reed (hip) and C Cade Mays (ankle) ruled out at MIA; WR Amon-Ra St. Brown (ribs) questionable.

BUF.text: OL: LT Dion Dawkins (ribs) and OT Alec Anderson (ankle) questionable for MNF at MIN. RT Spencer Brown has no designation.

NE.text: WR A.J. Brown (knee/ankle) out vs GB after sitting out Friday. TE Hunter Henry (foot) and RT Morgan Moses (foot) questionable.

NYJ.text: WR Garrett Wilson (concussion) out at KC; Adonai Mitchell and Omar Cooper the top WRs.
RB Breece Hall back from a five-game absence; carries to be split with Braelon Allen.

CAR.text: LBs Jaelan Phillips (hamstring) and Bobby Okereke (foot), CB Will Lee III (hamstring) and G Damien Lewis (knee) ruled out vs DEN. CB Akayleb Evans on IR.

DEN.text: Secondary: CB Kris Abrams-Draine (ankle) and S Brandon Jones (hamstring) ruled out at CAR; S Talanoa Hufanga (ankle) questionable.

IND.text: Defense: S A.J. Haulcy (ankle), CB Justin Walley (knee) and LB Akeem Davis-Gaither (knee) out vs DAL. OT Jalen Travis (thumb) questionable.

KC.text: Secondary: CB Mansoor Delane (shoulder) out vs NYJ, CB L'Jarius Sneed (knee) on IR.

WAS.text: DL: Daron Payne (foot) and Javon Kinlaw (MCL) had season-ending surgery. WRs Treylon Burks and Dyami Brown ruled out vs LA; Terry McLaurin (knee) on IR.

SF.text: DE Nick Bosa (knee) has no designation vs LV after missing time since Week 2. RB Christian McCaffrey (hamstring) also no designation.

DAL.text: WR George Pickens (hamstring) questionable at IND after limited practices. S Caleb Downs (concussion) has no designation.

TB.text: WR Emeka Egbuka (foot) questionable at CHI after missing two games. LT Tristan Wirfs (toe) has no designation.

NO.text: LT Kelvin Banks Jr. (ankle), out since Week 2, questionable vs CLE after his IR return window opened.
